title: A Unified Kullback--Leibler Divergence Analysis of Generative Diffusion Models via Entropy Production Rate
summary: We introduce a unified framework for the error analysis of generative models based on the entropy production rate of the forward-reverse diffusion process pair. For a pair of continuity equation flows, the rate admits a closed velocity form identity whose time integral decomposes the terminal Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence into the sum of an initialization error, a score approximation error, and a time-discretization error.
